Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

- Command to control the previous or next track for both FM and music.


| Head  |Len   | Cmd   |Data|Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes) |0x12 |data| xx |0x02   |

Data: Previous track: 0, Next track: 1.
